content.comment_body: Hello, I am programming a system with a [product_name] [article_no] and a [product_name] panel. I'm transferring values from the panel to the [product_name] using network analog input and VW tags, and this works well. The issue arises when the system reboots—the [product_name] does not read the initial values set by the panel, and I have to re-enter them every time the power cycles. The I/O field mode is currently set to 'Input.' If I switch to 'Input/Output,' after a power loss, it reads a zero from the [product_name]. For some reason, the program on the [product_name] defaults to zero and does not take the values from the panel. Is there a way to set an initial value from the programming environment rather than from the panel? Sorry for my English.

Hello [user_name], the panel does not retain values from the [product_name]. You need to store these values externally, such as on a separate chip. For example, see this: [url]. By following this approach, the panel can read the last value from the [product_name] after a restart. Best regards, [user_name]

Thank you, but my requirement is for the [product_name] to read the panel's initial values upon startup. For instance, I have an I/O field set as input with a starting value of 10. When the [product_name] starts, it does not read this initial value of 10—I have to manually set it in the I/O field, after which the [product_name] picks it up. I'm unsure why it doesn't read the preset value at the beginning.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that the [product_name] device does not automatically read or retain the start-up values configured on the panel after a reboot, requiring manual input of values following each power cycle. This results in inconvenience and inefficiency, as users expect seamless transfer and persistence of initial parameters between the control device and HMI panel. The feedback highlights unmet expectations regarding initial value retention and parameter handling across restarts.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] to automatically read and use the initial value set on the HMI panel during start-up without requiring manual input after each power cycle.
